This final panel must preserve the chosen rear-view backpack geometry and colors; no added exhaust turbines.
Keep the same two grille shapes, orange casing frame and two fin shapes across the three views. Lower concealed grille must visibly belong to the folding rear cassette; no appearing from nowhere. Full module visible with ample spacing.
